import sys

def str_to_int_arr(s):
    s_arr = s.split(" ")
    return [int(x) for x in s_arr]

class Cutting:
    def get_max_cuts(self, n, b, a_arr):
        length = len(a_arr)
        valid = [False] * length
        even = 0
        for i in range(length):
            if (a_arr[i] & 1) == 0:
                even += 1
            odd = (i + 1) - even
            if i > 0 and i < length - 1 and even == odd:
                valid[i] = True
        
        used = [False] * length
        n_coins = b
        n_cuts = 0
        while n_coins > 0:
            min_cost = n_coins + 1
            min_ind = -1
            for i in range(1, length - 1):
                if valid[i] and not used[i]:
                    cost = abs(a_arr[i] - a_arr[i + 1])
                    if cost < min_cost:
                        min_cost = cost
                        min_ind = i
            if min_ind == -1:
                break
            used[min_ind] = True
            n_coins -= min_cost
            n_cuts += 1
        return n_cuts

def main():
    nb_line = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    a_line = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    nb_arr = str_to_int_arr(nb_line)
    a_arr = str_to_int_arr(a_line)
    cut = Cutting()
    n = nb_arr[0]
    b = nb_arr[1]
    max_c = cut.get_max_cuts(n, b, a_arr)
    sys.stdout.write(str(max_c) + "\n")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
